title: Why AI Is WEIRD and Should Not Be This Way: Towards AI For Everyone, With Everyone, By Everyone

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing existing literature on 'WEIRD' (Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich, and Democratic) representation in AI, analyzing Western-centric norms in existing bias evaluation metrics (such as WEAT and SEAT), and surveying culturally aware benchmarks and alignment tests (e.g., Hofstede's Cultural Alignment Test).

Surveying disparities in model generalization and performance across diverse linguistic communities and dialects, and reviewing specialized benchmarks (e.g., VALUE, DADA) used to handle multilingual and multi-dialectal nuances.

Analyzing literature that documents disparities in model performance across different geographical locations, income levels, and social strata, highlighting how web-scraping data collection inherently excludes populations with limited internet access.
